name: ts-rag
description: RAG example monorepo — see apps/api, apps/ingest, apps/frontend, packages/embeddings

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ts-rag/embeddings && npm run build -w @ts-rag/api -w @ts-rag/ingest -w @ts-rag/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ts-rag/embeddings && concurrently -n api,ingest,frontend -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @ts-rag/api" "npm run dev -w @ts-rag/ingest" "npm run dev -w @ts-rag/frontend"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @ts-rag/embeddings && npm run dev -w @ts-rag/api
scripts.dev:ingest: npm run build -w @ts-rag/embeddings && npm run dev -w @ts-rag/ingest
scripts.start: npm run build -w @ts-rag/embeddings && npm run build -w @ts-rag/api && npm run start -w @ts-rag/api
scripts.start:ingest: npm run build -w @ts-rag/embeddings && npm run build -w @ts-rag/ingest && npm run start -w @ts-rag/ingest
scripts.preload: npm run build -w @ts-rag/embeddings && npm run preload -w @ts-rag/api
scripts.populate: npm run build -w @ts-rag/embeddings && npm run populate -w @ts-rag/ingest

author: dan byrne <danielbyrne@outlook.com>
